mapper.update: UPDATE `order` SET payment_type = #{paymentType}, payment_time = #{paymentTime}, status = #{status}, version = version + 1 WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND version = #{version}
UPDATE `order` SET delivery_time = #{deliveryTime}, status = #{status}, version = version + 1 WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND version = #{version}
mapper.select: SELECT o.*, ua.receiver_name, ua.receiver_phone, ua.province, ua.city, ua.district, ua.detail_address FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN user_address ua ON o.address_id = ua.address_id WHERE o.order_no = #{orderNo} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `order` WHERE DATE(created_at) = #{date} AND status IN (1, 2, 3)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `order` WHERE DATE(created_at) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND status IN (1, 2, 3)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(payment_amount), 0) FROM `order` WHERE DATE(created_at) = #{date} AND status IN (1, 2, 3)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(payment_amount), 0) FROM `order` WHERE DATE(created_at) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND status IN (1, 2, 3)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(payment_amount), 0) FROM `order` WHERE status IN (1, 2, 3)
SELECT * FROM `order` WHERE status = 0 AND created_at <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{timeoutMinutes} MINUTE) ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 100
